shortDescription: Browse daily notes in calendar or Margin views, capture quick thoughts, and summarize journal activity with Tally.
githubDescription: A calm calendar for daily notes in Obsidian, with Week, Month, Year, and continuous Margin views, optional day names, Quick Log, image covers, and Tally summaries.
communityLongDescription: Browse your daily notes in a compact sidebar calendar with week, month, and year views. Choose the continuous Margin layout for a coiled date spine, optional day names, linked titles, and folded gaps, or keep the standard calendar with image covers.

Use Quick Log to add timestamped thoughts to today's note. Tally summarizes daily notes, words, photos, checked items, and tagged counters for a selected week, month, or year. Save a Markdown report when you want a lasting overview.
Daymark follows your journal folder, date format, and daily note template, including nested paths. If a note is missing, Daymark asks before creating it.
readmeIntroduction: Daymark brings a calm calendar to your daily notes. Browse your journal in Week, Month, or Year view with optional image covers, or choose Margin for a continuous timeline with a coiled spine, day names, linked notes, and folded gaps.

Quick Log adds timestamped thoughts to today's note. Tally summarizes writing, photos, checked items, and tagged activities for the selected week, month, or year, and can save those summaries as Markdown reports.
Use your existing journal folder, date format, and daily-note template, including nested paths. Daymark opens existing notes immediately and asks before creating a missing one.
